integrity: The proof starts from the exact source formula, applies the gamma duplication identity, and reduces the derivative to a strictly increasing digamma expression. Existence and uniqueness use exact special-function identities; endpoint expansions use standard convergent/asymptotic gamma expansions. Numerical values are consistency checks only.
scientific_limitations: This is a parameter classification of the source-proved exact Hilbert-Fock Korenblum radius for the stretched-exponential family. It does not extend the exact-radius theorem to other weights or to non-Hilbert exponents. The minimizing exponent is characterized implicitly by a digamma equation rather than an algebraic closed form.
title: A unique minimum in the stretched-exponential Fock Korenblum radius
